packageRules.description: One weekly PR for all CI action pins: each separate merge into the CI workflow files used to trigger its own full pipeline, so five overnight action bumps meant five back-to-back gate cycles.
upload/download-artifact v4+ speak the github.com-only artifact protocol and self-refuse on self-hosted CI; stay on v3 until the self-hosted runner implements the v4 API.
One weekly PR for Rust lockfile-only bumps (a Cargo.lock change rebuilds and redeploys the production image, which is correct but should batch).
